subject: Private Offer: performance milestone rev-share ladder + Net-90 billing (escalation)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Doss <anna.doss@edgelytics.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer: performance milestone rev-share ladder + Net-90 billing (initial request)

Anna — thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Edgelytics is asking for a private AWS Marketplace offer with two non-standard items that require exec signoff: 1) a milestone-based rev-share ladder (higher rev-share for first $500k, then step-downs tied to consumption milestones), and 2) Net-90 payment terms with deferred revenue recognition language and a gross-up for tax withholdings.

Attached is the draft private offer (Edgelytics_Private_Offer_v2.pdf) and a proposed rev-share schedule (revshare_milestone_schedule.xlsx). Key points:
- Rev-share ladder: 30% on first $500k ARR billed, 22% for $500k–$2M, 15% thereafter. Milestones measured by cumulative billings on marketplace listing.
- Performance milestone triggers: 95th percentile latency <= 120ms and sustained throughput for 30 days for the first tier to step down.
- Billing: Net-90 requested; Edgelytics says they need that for cashflow alignment with their customer receipts.
- Recognition: They want deferred recognition for the ramp months; finance/legal will need to confirm acceptable wording.

Can you review and confirm if we can approve Net-90 for this account and whether the rev-share ladder is acceptable as-is? If you want, I can escalate to deal desk/legal for the tax/gross-up clause.

Next steps I'm proposing: Jordan -> deal desk/finance for Net-90 and tax carveout approval; legal review of deferred recognition language; if approved, proceed to DocuSign and AWS private listing.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0139

Attachments: Edgelytics_Private_Offer_v2.pdf (pdf); revshare_milestone_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Anna Doss <anna.doss@edgelytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: performance milestone rev-share ladder + Net-90 billing (clarification)

Jordan — thanks for the draft and for outlining the milestones. A couple quick clarifications before we escalate to legal/finance:
- The milestone measurement window: can we define the 30-day sustained throughput window as calendar days after listing go-live? Edgelytics prefers a calendar-month anchor.
- For Net-90, procurement will need an explicit invoicing cadence (monthly in arrears) and a PO to bind. Will Redwood accept PO + credit check as condition?
- Tax gross-up: this is non-negotiable for our VAT reporting in EMEA, though our initial usage will be US-first.

If you can incorporate those items, procurement will sign faster.

Best,
Anna Doss
VP Partnerships | Edgelytics Inc.
anna.doss@edgelytics.com

---
Attachment: procurement_term_sheet.docx (referenced)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Doss <anna.doss@edgelytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-04T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: performance milestone rev-share ladder + Net-90 billing (answers)

Anna — thanks, noted. Quick answers inline: 
- Measurement window: we can align milestone start to the calendar month after AWS private listing goes live. I'll add that to the milestone schedule.
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood can invoice monthly in arrears. Net-90 acceptance will be conditional on a valid PO and a standard credit check/finance approval. I'll flag to finance for a rapid review.
- Tax gross-up: I'll escalate this to legal; need to confirm whether a gross-up or alternate VAT routing (reverse charge) is feasible.

Karthik/Monica — please see attached drafts. We need a quick finance credit assessment and legal take on gross-up vs reverse charge. Also want to confirm whether we can support a canary AWS listing (limited region) while we complete terms, to avoid delaying Edgelytics' product launch.

Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier in thread:
> Anna — thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Edgelytics is asking for a private AWS Marketplace offer with two non-standard items...

From: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-05T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Edgelytics private offer — approve Net-90 + milestone rev-share ladder?

Markus / Monica / Karthik —

Summarizing request for exec/finance/legal clearance so we can finalize DL-2028-0782 (Edgelytics):
1) Approve Net-90 payment terms, conditional on valid PO + credit check. They are asking Net-90 due to downstream receivable cadence.
2) Approve milestone-based rev-share ladder as proposed (30% first $500k, 22% next $1.5M, 15% thereafter). Milestone step-downs tied to performance SLAs (latency/throughput) with month-based measurement windows.
3) Legal: advise on tax gross-up vs reverse charge for EMEA exposure; Edgelytics requests explicit gross-up clause.
4) Finance: confirm whether deferred revenue recognition language (ramp months) is acceptable and whether we need a prepayment or credit hold for Net-90.
5) Ops: permission to create a canary AWS private listing (us-east-1 only) to start the integration while terms finalize.

Attachments included for review: Edgelytics_Private_Offer_v2.pdf; revshare_milestone_schedule.xlsx; credit_policy_note.pdf

Requested turnaround: 48 hours — Edgelytics' launch schedule is tight. If we can't approve Net-90, we should decide whether to offer Net-45 or require a 10% upfront to mitigate credit risk.

Thanks — Jordan

(Please reply-all with decision bullets so I can relay to Edgelytics.)

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-06T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Edgelytics private offer — approve Net-90 + milestone rev-share ladder?

Jordan / team —

High level: I am inclined to approve the rev-share ladder as it aligns incentives for early adoption, but need stricter credit mitigations for Net-90. 
Decision bullets: 
- Rev-share ladder: APPROVED as proposed.
- Net-90: CONDITIONAL approval — limit to an initial 6-month Net-90 pilot period. Require either (A) a 10% upfront prepayment, or (B) an approved credit line from Finance (credit check + guarantor). If neither is acceptable, fallback to Net-45.
- Deferred recognition: Finance to confirm; likely acceptable with explicit ramp schedule and no change to our revenue recognition policy.
- Tax/gross-up: Legal should explore reverse-charge mechanism first; gross-up only if reverse-charge is unavailable.
- Canary listing: Ops may proceed in us-east-1 but must restrict SKU visibility and impose rate limits until terms signed.

Karthik / Monica — please run the credit check and confirm whether we can approve the pilot Net-90 with a credit guardrail. Legal: please advise on reverse charge feasibility for Edgelytics' EMEA exposures.

Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: credit_policy_note.pdf (summary of finance guardrails)

Anna / Edgelytics procurement — quick update and next steps after internal review: 
- Rev-share ladder: APPROVED as proposed.
- Net-90: Conditional approval for an initial 6-month Net-90 pilot. Condition: Edgelytics must provide a PO and either (A) 10% upfront prepayment or (B) pass Redwood's standard credit check and receive an approved credit line. Finance will reach out to procurement with a short form.
- Tax: Legal is evaluating reverse-charge flow; if not viable, we'll consider gross-up language as fallback.
- Canary listing: We can open a limited AWS private listing in us-east-1 with rate limits while we finalize contracts.

Next steps for Edgelytics (please confirm by return):
1) Share PO or confirm intent to prepay 10% (invoice to be issued upon signature).
2) Complete Redwood credit questionnaire: https://finance.redwood.ai/credit-form (Finance will send link and checklist).
3) Legal to review updated private offer — I have uploaded the DocuSign powerform for signature: https://na2.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?powerFormId=abc-priv-offer-2028
